Why Folks Drive Up Here

A mountain-town shop, not a big-box counter

You'll talk to someone who hunts these ridges — not a register with a vest on. That's the whole difference.

Honest, No-Pressure Advice

New to hunting or kitting out for a big trip? We'll steer you to what works and talk you out of what you don't need. You leave with the right gear, not the priciest.

Hunters Who Actually Hunt

Our crew runs these same woods every season. Ask about the ridge, the rut, or what's patterning — chances are somebody behind the counter was out there last weekend.

Gunsmithing Under One Roof

Sight-ins, cleanings, repairs, and scope mounting handled in-house by a smith who's been at it for decades. No shipping your rifle off and waiting a month.

FFL Transfers Done Right

Bought online? Ship it here and we'll handle the transfer and background check on site — fast, friendly, and strictly by the book.

Stocked for the Season

Deer, turkey, upland, and the range — we keep the calibers and gear North Georgia actually uses on the shelf, so you're not driving to the city the night before opening day.

Questions

Frequently asked

What do I need to buy a firearm here?

A valid government-issued photo ID and a passed background check. You'll need to meet federal and Georgia age requirements — 18+ for long guns, 21+ for handguns. We run the check on site, and most clear within minutes.

Can I ship an online purchase to you for a transfer?

Absolutely — we're a licensed FFL dealer. Have the seller ship to us, bring your ID, and we'll handle the transfer and background check when it arrives. Give us a call for our current transfer fee.

Do you do gunsmithing, sight-ins, and scope mounting?

We do — cleaning, repairs, trigger and stock work, plus scope mounting and bore-sighting, all by our licensed gunsmith on site. Most jobs are back in your hands in about a week, depending on parts.

Do you buy, sell, and trade used firearms?

Yes. Bring it by and we'll take a look and make you a fair offer. Used firearms go through the same legal transfer and background-check process as new ones — no shortcuts.

Will you have ammo for my caliber?

We stock a wide range of rifle, shotgun, pistol, and rimfire ammo focused on what North Georgia hunters and shooters use most. For bulk orders or hard-to-find calibers, call ahead and we'll do our best to get it in.

What are your hours?

Monday through Friday 9 to 6, Saturday 8 to 5, and we're closed Sundays. During deer and turkey season the Saturday mornings fill up fast — come early if you can.
